_comment: PATCH /repos/{owner}/{repo} (https://docs.github.com/en/rest/repos/repos#update-a-repository). Squash only, titled by the pull request: the subject on main is then the title the PR policy check verified (imperative, at most 72 characters, no prefix), and the body keeps the commit messages.
Issues and Discussions stay on: the issue forms and SECURITY.md link them. Secret scanning and push protection stay on (enabled in Phase 0); this file keeps them from being turned off silently.
